comment: Halogenation of various peptidyl-S-carrier in the teicoplanin pathway. The carrier proteins PCP1 and PCP2 are encoded by tcp9, PCP6 by tcp11. Stereochemistry could not be depicted due to incompatibility with validation engine.

changelog.comment: New entry. Clarified enzyme description. Removed unnecessary review reference.

reactions.description: Chlorination of carrier-S-L-tyrosine. Substrate together with a carrier protein determine the selectivity. The activity of the L-tyrosine moiety with different carrier proteins in the same pathway could hint at regulatory activities. Carrier proteins: PCP1,2 and 6
Chlorination in position 3 of carrier-bound L-tyrosine.
